quote: At any rate, that is happiness; to be dissolved into something complete and great.
source: Willa Cather, My Ántonia, Book I, The Shimerdas, ch. II (Jim Burden) (1918)
speaker: Jim Burden
note: Corrected the locator. The sentence is not the closing words of the chapter but the second to last. Book I, chapter II ends with the sentence beginning When it comes to one. Cather frames the whole narrative as Jim Burden’s manuscript, so the speaker stands.
